messages:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up: need a decision on how we handle late/orphaned tokens when compacting the metering ledger. Two high-level options: tombstone/eager-finalize vs append-only + reconciliation. Opinions?

maria: append-only + reconciliation. Tombstones make repairs painful and increase GC complexity. Storage cost is acceptable short-term.

jamal: auditability forces append-only for me. If we delete raw events we need guaranteed rehydration points or hashes.

cassidy: what about customer-facing proofs? RFC suggested Merkle roots. If we backfill a window, do we mutate the invoice root? That's a no from finance.

alex: idea: keep immutable invoice snapshots (merkle root signed), and publish corrections as a separate signed corrections ledger. So base invoice never changes; corrections are replayable deltas.

luis: sounds good. Implementation detail: finalization events should include ingest offset and a hash of raw payload: finalize(token_id, offset, window_id, raw_hash). Store raw blobs in S3; keep hash pointer in compact ledger.

jamal: verification flow: auditor fetches snapshot, applies any corrections, then requests raw blobs for sampled tokens to validate hashes. Need retention policy e.g., 3 years.

maria: streaming merkle (incremental roots keyed by ingest offset) vs batch snapshot at window close? Streaming cheaper at peak if offsets are monotonic. We already have offsets.

cassidy: prefer streaming if we can guarantee ordering determinism. Else batch. Also add redaction path: legal takedown may require deleting raw, but keep a signed redaction event.

alex: agreed. Action items: I will write follow-up RFC favoring append-only + corrections ledger, streaming merkle via ingest offsets, and breadcrumb hashes to cold storage. Luis: draft S3 lifecycle + access lib. Jamal/Maria: finance/test acceptance plan. Cassidy: proof verification API.

luis: I'll estimate storage costs for hot index vs cold raw and include lifecycle (GLACIER after 90d).

sre-bot: Deploy finished: metering-snapshotter v2.1 -> prod at 2024-10-03T13:24:00Z
